headline: Pope's AI encyclical lifts Reversion and Gatekeeper
body: The Vatican published Magnifica Humanitas, Pope Leo XIV's encyclical on AI, which calls for robust regulation, opposes AI in warfare and defends workers and human dignity; Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah appeared alongside the Pope. A moral voice of that reach adds to Tech Backlash, which lifts Reversion (a world that turns away from advanced tech), and to Global Coordination, which helps Gatekeeper. The UK and Australia also signed AI security agreements between their safety institutes, another boost for Global Coordination. More cooperation means less room for runaway conflict, so Self-Destruction fell. Conquerors and Self-Destruction swapped places in the ranking. Horizon Balance is 0.5, up 0.03.
movers_note: Reversion +0.8, from the papal encyclical (+0.80); Gatekeeper +0.5, from the encyclical (+0.28) and the UK-Australia agreements (+0.21); Self-Destruction -0.4 from both (-0.20 and -0.15).
